changelog: Burst + chain v0.5.11: Fixed the '3-round burst lightning gun' generation failure — generation no longer fails with "unknown block field 'hooks'" (hooks nested inside the block now validate). New BURST fire mode (fire_mode + burst_size — one trigger press fires N rounds) and CHAIN projectiles (chain_targets / chain_radius / chain_falloff / element — each hit jumps to a nearby enemy for falloff damage with the element rider).
